sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: A square patio of side 11 m is to be paved at $9 per square metre. Find the total cost, and state which quantity the cost is proportional to.
choices: $99; the cost is proportional to the area
$1089; the cost is proportional to the side length
$1089; the cost is proportional to the area
$396; the cost is proportional to the perimeter
